segments.text: We first tried Basic machine learning forecast in 206. At the time, market pressure mattered because we wanted to stop stock-outs during festive seasons.
The biggest issue was Import restrictions. Without steady power in Enugu, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after Basic machine learning forecast—we saw Customer retention within 3 months.
Policy-wise, Data protection shaped our move. We adjusted by Peer learning.
Data helped; even a moving-average model gave us clearer demand patterns during Back-to-school.
